name: Slave Of Lust
source:
Slave Of Lust is a visual novel exclusively for adults! This story tells the story of two university students who came to help a teacher. But they are locked in the same room. At this point, instincts kick in and the students get closer...

In this wonderful game you have to plunge into the story of two students who, at the request of the teacher, come to help clean the office. They never got along, but a common misfortune rallied them and the couple formed a romantic relationship. What happened next you will see in the game. Get real pleasure from a very simple gameplay and cool music.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155970/Slave_Of_Lust/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《色欲之奴》是一款专为成人打造的视觉小说！故事讲述两名大学生应邀前去给老师帮忙，却意外被反锁在了同一个房间里。此时此刻，原始本能悄然苏醒，两名学生的距离也越靠越近……

在这部精彩的作品中，你将深入体验两名学生的故事：应老师之托前来帮忙打扫办公室的两人平日里一向合不来，然而一场共同遭遇的意外却让他们冰释前嫌，进而擦出了恋爱的火花。后续发展就留待你在游戏中亲自见证吧——伴随着轻松简洁的玩法与动感十足的音乐，尽享纯粹愉悦的体验。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155970/Slave_Of_Lust/]Steam[/url]]
